name: Japan 15 km all seven JAC PoC mods: continuous 20-turn timing/memory and save/load measurements (Ryukyu human)

steps.code: local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=204 or h~=88 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; if #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()~=22 then error('initial major count') end; local cities=0; for i=0,21 do cities=cities+Players[i]:GetCities():GetCount() end; if cities~=56 then error('initial city count '..cities) end; return '15 km historical map: 22 majors, 56 cities'

if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; local t,c=0,0; for row in GameInfo.Technologies() do t=t+1; if not string.find(row.TechnologyType,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech: '..row.TechnologyType) end end; for row in GameInfo.Civics() do c=c+1; if not string.find(row.CivicType,'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official civic: '..row.CivicType) end end; if t~=32 or c~=30 then error('wrong tree counts '..t..'/'..c) end; if GameInfo.Eras['ERA_ANCIENT'].Name~='LOC_JAC_ERA_TENBUN_NAME' then error('Sengoku era missing') end; if not GameClimate or not GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange or not Game.GetWorldCongress then error('GS core APIs missing') end; if GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange()==nil or not Game.GetWorldCongress() then error('GS systems inactive') end; return '32 techs, 30 civics, GS systems present'

local t=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); if t~=1 then error('turn mismatch '..t) end; if Game.GetLocalPlayer()~=0 or PlayerConfigurations[0]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~='CIVILIZATION_JAC_RYUKYU' or not Players[0]:IsAlive() then error('Ryukyu must survive for reload') end; return 'measurement checkpoint turn='..t

local function encode(v)
  local t=type(v)
  if t=='nil' then return 'nil' end
  if t=='string' then return string.format('%q',v) end
  if t=='number' or t=='boolean' then return t..':'..tostring(v) end
  if t~='table' then error('unsupported saved property type '..t) end
  local keys={}
  for k in pairs(v) do keys[#keys+1]=k end
  table.sort(keys,function(a,b) return type(a)..':'..tostring(a)<type(b)..':'..tostring(b) end)
  local out={}
  for _,k in ipairs(keys) do out[#out+1]=encode(k)..'='..encode(v[k]) end
  return '{'..table.concat(out,',')..'}'
end
local state={turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),
  ledger=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER'),
  resources=Game:GetProperty('JAC_RESOURCE_SITES_REVEALED'),
  resourceBaseline=Game:GetProperty('JAC_RESOURCE_TECH_BASELINE'),
  events=Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT'),
  bundle0=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_BUNDLE0_STATE'),
  growthInitialized=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_INITIALIZED'),players={},owners={}}
if type(state.ledger)~='table' then error('ledger missing') end
if state.growthInitialized~=true then error('growth initialization missing') end
for i=0,21 do
  local p=Players[i]; if not p then error('player slot missing '..i) end
  local row={alive=p:IsAlive(),cities={},units={},techs={},civics={}}
  for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do
    row.units[#row.units+1]={id=u:GetID(),owner=u:GetOwner(),kind=u:GetUnitType(),x=u:GetX(),y=u:GetY(),
      damage=u:GetDamage(),warlord=u:GetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_WARLORD')}
  end
  table.sort(row.units,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
  if i==Game.GetLocalPlayer() then
    local growth=0
    for _,u in ipairs(row.units) do
      if type(u.warlord)=='table' and type(u.warlord.Level)=='number' and type(u.warlord.XP)=='number' then growth=growth+1 end
    end
    if growth<1 then error('human growth record missing') end
  end
  for _,c in p:GetCities():Members() do
    row.cities[#row.cities+1]={id=c:GetID(),x=c:GetX(),y=c:GetY(),population=c:GetPopulation()}
  end
  table.sort(row.cities,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
  for r in GameInfo.Technologies() do if p:GetTechs():HasTech(r.Index) then row.techs[#row.techs+1]=r.TechnologyType end end
  for r in GameInfo.Civics() do if p:GetCulture():HasCivic(r.Index) then row.civics[#row.civics+1]=r.CivicType end end
  table.sort(row.techs); table.sort(row.civics)
  state.players['p'..i]=row
end
local last,count=nil,0
for i=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do
  local owner=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i):GetOwner()
  if owner==last then count=count+1
  else
    if count>0 then state.owners[#state.owners+1]={owner=last,count=count} end
    last,count=owner,1
  end
end
if count>0 then state.owners[#state.owners+1]={owner=last,count=count} end
return encode(state)
